Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 11 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Sonali - 35 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Siya - 8 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
4. Vimla - 73 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
5. Riya - 12 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
4. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Ayaan stands by the road. Sonali, Siya and Vimla stand near him.]

Sonali: "What lovely weather!"

[Ayaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Vimla: "That was fun!"

[Ayaan gets into the car.]

Sonali (surprised): "And then?"

[Ayaan gets on the bus.]

Ayaan: "Show me too!"

[Ayaan gets off the school bus.]

Siya: "How beautiful!"

[Ayaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Vimla (gently): "Well done!"

[Ayaan pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Siya: "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Sonali and Vimla stand near him.]

Ayaan: "Look over here."

[Ayaan slips and falls.]

Ayaan: "Oh wow!"

[Ayaan trips over a stone.]

Ayaan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Ayaan hurts his knee.]

Vimla: "Oh wow!"

[Ayaan helps Mother get up.]

Sonali (softly): "Well done!"

[Ayaan sneezes loudly.]

Vimla: "That was fun!"

[Ayaan coughs.]

Ayaan: "Careful!"

Scene 3: The kitchen - Day

[Ayaan stands in the kitchen. Sonali stands near him.]

Ayaan: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan chops onions for the curry.]

Ayaan (excited): "Really?"

[Ayaan washes the dishes after dinner.]

Ayaan: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 4: The living room - Day

[Ayaan stands in the living room. Sonali, Vimla and Riya stand near him.]

Vimla: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Ayaan: "Exactly right."

[Ayaan munches on an apple.]

Sonali: "I'm ready!"

[Ayaan's phone rings and he answers it.]

Ayaan: "One more time!"

[Ayaan watches cartoons on TV.]

Ayaan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
